title: GUARD (fixed in b43aa1f72a) — was: under zh_CN.GB2312 / ja_JP.eucJP a _describe description wider than the screen was cut one BYTE at a time, so the listing stopped after the first two-byte character where zsh copies whole characters up to the width

observed.notes: Src/Zle/computil.c:695-715 copies a too-wide description one MB_METACHARLEN unit at a time, charging each its ZMB_nicewidth. MB_METACHARLEN is the locale's mbrtowc, so in GB2312 (MB_CUR_MAX 2) a unit is a two-byte character.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: main at 12f728f349, target/debug/zshrs zshrs 0.13.56, against /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh 5.9.2 (grid text is the GB2312 bytes as the UTF-8 pyte screen decodes them)

retired.why: cd_get's copy_desc gated its byte-at-a-time walk on CODESET != UTF-8, which only fits MB_CUR_MAX == 1. It now also requires MB_CUR_MAX == 1, so multibyte codesets take mb_metacharlenconv's whole-character unit.

controls.note: a description that fits the width is copied whole by c:697-698 and agrees with or without the fix

origin: hand-built from round-2 lead (computil.rs copy_desc), seed range 310000; confirmed against zsh 5.9.2

confirmed.note: pre-fix FAIL measured on 12f728f349 for GB2312 only, through a --replay file carrying the same completer with the description as raw GB2312 bytes instead of $'\x..' escapes; the eucJP variant was measured PASS after the fix only. Fixture cell, control and variant PASS after the fix.
